tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Fresh original reusable children's educational sprite sheet drawn from the attached adopted identity/style reference, NOT a pixel edit.
Subject: Golden Lion Tamarin (ゴールデンライオンタマリン). Preserve this exact adopted individual, palette, warm brown contour thickness, gentle painted paper texture, face and all asymmetric colour patches, markings, tail side and appendage counts. Keep the established lightly anthropomorphic upright short bipedal design, same big head, short torso and two existing forearms and two feet. Preserve the exact reference eye format: white eye shapes with plain brown pupils and NO sparkle highlights.
Important visible identity: 金橙の毛・顔周りのたてがみ形・一本尾. No added clothing, props or decorations.
Composition: requested3072x3072 square transparent RGBA image, conceptual3x3 equal cells, one complete isolated full-body figure in each cell, no drawn grid, labels, text or numbers. Maximize usable native figure pixels but keep comfortable transparent margins, including any horns, tail and wings. All nine drawings share the same head/trunk natural scale, camera angle and contour weight. Never fit a tilted/crouched pose separately to its cell, never mirror source markings. No touching/crossing cell boundaries.
POSE ORDER row-major:
1 top-left blink: Change ONLY eyes to soft closed curved lines. Keep exact reference standing/body/torso/head dimensions, head height, support position and appendages. No shorter torso or dropped head.
2 top-middle greet: Gentle visible welcome using one existing forepaw; all other appendages retained, support stable.
3 top-right present_left: Clearly attend or indicate toward VIEWER LEFT using one existing forepaw; preserve original asymmetric markings and tail side.
4 middle-left present_right: Clearly attend or indicate toward VIEWER RIGHT using one existing forepaw; independently drawn, not mirrored.
5 middle-middle think: Gentle curious/pondering expression with a small head tilt; one existing paw near cheek.
6 middle-right aha: Gentle discovery, original open eyes with clear friendly attentive expression; one paw raised slightly; no symbols.
7 bottom-left cheer: Mild happy celebration using existing appendages, preserve actual support/float type; no invented jump or floating duplicate feet.
8 bottom-middle species_a: Curl only the end of the single reference tail a little more; keep the mascot stance and arms near neutral.
9 bottom-right species_b: The same tail tip relaxes part-way back toward its original curve; no change to body scale or foot support.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with generated alpha. No text, labels, watermarks, grid lines, ground, cast shadows, motion lines, effect symbols or background scenery. Exactly one same character per cell. Crisp contours and clean intentional soft painted surfaces, no muddy smears, paint bleeding or colour lumps. No extra/missing/disconnected limbs, tail, toes, wings, fins or horns. Open-eye shape must match source, no highlights. No redesign or extra detailed realism. Keep good native pixel resolution for existing maximum-use educational video display.
